rules: Keep total video length strictly between 30 and 50 seconds to match top performing pacing.
Open every video with an on-screen hook title in the first 3 seconds.
Maintain the strict narrator split: host handles hooks and prediction prompts, explainer delivers the science.
Use real-world footage or clean drawn diagrams/maps; never use photo-real AI images.
End every video with the signature closing 'Ever thought why...' question to drive loops.
formats_now: Transportation danger/survival mechanics: high views on train and aviation safety because the physical stakes are instantly clear.
Industrial scale creation: viewers engage heavily with 'how X is made in factories' due to satisfying mechanical repetition.
Counter-intuitive physics phenomena: breaking down hidden forces in everyday objects drives high retention.
